meta.description: Latest US retail price per model joined to its Blender benchmark score.

sources.name: Amazon US listings via Bright Data
sources.licence: Amazon's Conditions of Use exclude "any collection and use of any product listings, descriptions, or prices" and "any use of data mining, robots, or similar data gathering and extraction tools". Bright Data's Master Service Agreement (https://brightdata.com/license) grants no rights in the collected data, bars republishing it to offer a competing product, and makes the customer solely responsible for lawful use. The owner chose (14 November 2026) to keep using these prices but never commit or publish the raw rows: they stay in a private Actions cache, and only derived tables reach the site.

sources.name: Best Buy listings via Bright Data
sources.licence: Best Buy's website terms have not been read for this project yet, so reuse rights are unconfirmed. Until they are, the rows are handled like Amazon's: never committed or published, kept in a private Actions cache, and only derived tables reach the site. Bright Data's Master Service Agreement (https://brightdata.com/license) grants no rights in the collected data and makes the customer solely responsible for lawful use.

sources.name: Central Computers online store
sources.licence: No data licence and no website-use terms found. The store's "Terms and Conditions" pages cover orders, returns and warranty; none of the text read mentions automated access or reuse. Public search pages are crawled only where robots.txt allows it. The site shows a lowest price per model with a link back, never the store's listings in bulk.

sources.name: eBay US Buy It Now listings (Browse API)
sources.licence: eBay API License Agreement (https://developer.ebay.com/join/api-license-agreement). Public display of derived lowest-price comparisons with a link back to the listing is permitted; raw listing feeds are not redistributed in bulk.

sources.name: Blender Open Data benchmark snapshots
sources.licence: CC0 (Creative Commons Zero), stated on https://opendata.blender.org/download/ and in the LICENSE.txt shipped in each snapshot. No conditions on reuse; the site credits it anyway.
sources.frequency: weekly collection; snapshots are regenerated daily

limitations: Prices are listing prices at the retailers named, not transaction prices. Coverage is limited to retailers that allow automated collection, so this is not the whole market.
The price shown is the cheapest new listing available online on the collection date.

Amazon prices count only listings sold by Amazon.com, Micro Center, or the part's own brand or board partner, and Best Buy prices only listings sold by Best Buy or Newegg Official. Other marketplace sellers are left out because their listings cannot be confirmed as new.
A price backed by a single listing is marked low confidence: it is often one marketplace seller's asking price for a discontinued part.
Score per dollar measures rendering throughput per dollar. It is a research lead, not buying advice.
Blender Open Data is crowd-submitted: cooling, memory and drivers are not controlled.
Scores come from a single Blender version and are never combined across versions.

finding.label: observation
finding.reason: Measured benchmark score divided by the lowest listed price. No model is involved.
